response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), s AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share FROM c) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff_from_avg FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
